name: topical
query_text: ( "temperature" OR "seasonal mean temperature" OR "seasonal average temperature" OR "seasonal max temperature" OR "seasonal min temperature" OR "seasonal average of daily maximum temperature" OR "seasonal average of daily minimum temperature" OR "seasonal mean of daily maximum temperature" OR "seasonal mean of daily minimum temperature" )
parsed_groups: seasonal average of daily maximum temperature
seasonal average of daily minimum temperature
seasonal mean of daily maximum temperature
seasonal mean of daily minimum temperature
matcher: per-section whole-word, case-insensitive, no stemming: regexp_matches(text, '\b'+escape(term)+'\b', 'i'); doc matches iff every group has a matching term in some section
